prompt: Ciara always tells friends that she (to live) five minutes from the sea.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол tells стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвиг времён не нужен — остаётся Present Simple.

prompt: Calling from the terminal, Deepak mentioned that he still (to manage) the ticket desk there.
explanation_ru: Факт по-прежнему верен (still), поэтому после mentioned можно оставить Present Simple или сделать обычный сдвиг в Past Simple.

prompt: Our guide explains that she ___ Italian, so I will translate for the group.
explanation_ru: После вводного глагола в настоящем времени (explains) время в придаточном не сдвигается; частая ошибка — ставить Past Simple по инерции.

prompt: Farid claims that he knew the gym receptionist, so he never shows his pass.
answer: Farid claims that he knows the gym receptionist, so he never shows his pass.
accepted_answers: Farid claims that he knows the gym receptionist, so he never shows his pass.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол claims стоит в настоящем времени, а ситуация актуальна сейчас (never shows), поэтому нужен Present Simple (knows), а не knew.

prompt: Gareth told me about his family. His two older brothers still live in Leeds.
options: Gareth said that his two brothers had lived in Leeds.
Gareth said that his two brothers live in Leeds.
Gareth said that his two brothers will live in Leeds.
Gareth said that his two brothers were living in Leeds.
explanation_ru: Братья до сих пор живут в Лидсе, поэтому Present Simple (live) точно передаёт постоянный и актуальный факт, тогда как had lived означало бы, что они уехали.

prompt: Does Hannah really claim that her uncle (to own) three bakeries in Bristol?
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол стоит в Present Simple (Does … claim), поэтому в придаточном время не сдвигается.

prompt: I invited Igor to a loud sports bar. He reminded me that he (not / to like) noisy cafés at all.
explanation_ru: Вкусы Игоря остаются прежними, поэтому после reminded допустимы оба варианта: без сдвига (doesn't like) и со сдвигом (didn't like).

prompt: Jiao has just told the coach that she ___ new glasses for reading.
explanation_ru: Когда вводный глагол стоит в Present Perfect (has just told), сдвиг времён не выполняется; ошибка — менять needs на needed.

prompt: Kwame always tells his guests, “I prefer green tea without milk.” → Kwame always tells his guests …
answer: Kwame always tells his guests that he prefers green tea without milk.
accepted_answers: Kwame always tells his guests that he prefers green tea without milk.
Kwame always tells his guests he prefers green tea without milk.
explanation_ru: Глагол tells стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому меняем только местоимение и окончание 3-го лица (he prefers), не сдвигая время в прошедшее.

prompt: The swimming timetable says that Liam (to teach) beginners on Tuesdays.
explanation_ru: Расписание сообщает о факте в настоящем времени (says), поэтому глагол остаётся в Present Simple (teaches).

prompt: Meera met me for coffee after her shift. She says she really (to enjoy) writing for the local paper. Years earlier, though, she told her parents she (not / to plan) to become a reporter. Luckily, she changed her mind at college. Before leaving, she mentioned that her editor still (to print) two of her stories each month.
explanation_ru: После says сдвига нет (enjoys); прошлые планы уже неактуальны, поэтому после told нужен сдвиг (didn't plan); после mentioned факт со словом still остаётся верным, поэтому возможны prints и printed.

prompt: A short post on Nabil's blog mentions that his mother (to feed) six hens.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол mentions стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому глагол в придаточном остаётся в Present Simple.

prompt: My cousin Orla told us that she always travels by train because she hates flying.
answer: My cousin Orla told us that she always travels by train because she hates flying.
accepted_answers: My cousin Orla told us that she always travels by train because she hates flying.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: привычка Орлы остаётся верной и сейчас, поэтому после told вполне допустимо не сдвигать Present Simple.

prompt: Family dinners rarely include Piotr, yet he insists that he (not / to belong) to that hiking club just to avoid them.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол insists стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвиг времён не требуется — используем отрицание в Present Simple.

prompt: Why has Qian told the optician that she ___ contact lenses anymore, even though she bought three boxes in March?
explanation_ru: После вводного глагола в Present Perfect (has told) время в придаточном не сдвигается; частая ошибка — выбрать didn't wear.

prompt: Rosa's bicycle broke near the market, so she rang my uncle for advice. He tells her that his neighbour (to repair) bikes for a fair price. Years ago, my uncle mentioned that the shop (to sell) only spare parts, though it handles full repairs today. My uncle texted her the exact street number. He also noted that the workshop still (to charge) less than the chain store.
explanation_ru: После tells время не меняется (repairs); старое правило мастерской уже не действует, поэтому нужен сдвиг (sold); актуальный факт со словом still после noted допускает charges и charged.

prompt: A quick message from Samira says she (to queue) for the bus.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол says стоит в настоящем времени, а действие происходит в момент речи, поэтому остаётся Present Continuous.

prompt: Nobody can reach Tariq. Didn't he tell us five minutes ago that he (to visit) his cousin right now?
explanation_ru: Речь передаётся почти сразу и ситуация длится прямо сейчас (right now), поэтому естественно оставить is visiting, хотя после Didn't he tell допустимо и was visiting.

prompt: Usha shouts from the kitchen that she (to cook) soup for all the guests, even though nobody has arrived from the station.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол shouts стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому действие в процессе передаётся через Present Continuous без сдвига.

prompt: Last winter, Viktor said that he is renting a hostel room in York, though he moved home in March.
answer: Last winter, Viktor said that he was renting a hostel room in York, though he moved home in March.
accepted_answers: Last winter, Viktor said that he was renting a hostel room in York, though he moved home in March.
explanation_ru: Ситуация уже закончилась (он вернулся домой в марте), поэтому после said нельзя оставлять настоящее время — нужен сдвиг в Past Continuous (was renting).

prompt: Wendy phoned me from the hallway in a panic. She says she (to search) for her wool scarf everywhere. Our neighbour mentioned that he still (to hold) a spare key, so we can check the porch. I looked behind the shoe rack without luck. Five minutes earlier, Wendy swore she (not / to pack) it in her gym bag, yet I pulled it straight out of the side pocket.
explanation_ru: После says оставляем Present Continuous (is searching); факт со словом still допускает holds и held; слова Венди о прошлом оказались неверны, поэтому после swore нужен сдвиг в прошедшее время.

prompt: Proud of his progress, Xavi's teacher reported that he (to learn) sign language to chat with his new classmate, and he attends lessons twice a week.
explanation_ru: Учёба продолжается до сих пор (attends lessons twice a week), поэтому после reported возможен как вариант без сдвига (is learning), так и со сдвигом (was learning).

prompt: Yuna burst into the staffroom with a stack of posters. She has just announced that she (to organise) the autumn concert on her own this year. Last term, she insisted that she (not / to enjoy) planning big events, so we were all surprised. Did anyone ask why she changed her mind? Actually, she explained that the headteacher (to promise) extra funding, and the money is already in the school account.
explanation_ru: После Present Perfect (has just announced) сдвига нет; прежнее мнение Юны изменилось, поэтому после insisted нужен сдвиг (didn't enjoy); обещанное финансирование актуально сейчас, поэтому после explained возможны has promised, had promised и promised.

prompt: This text from Zofia explains that she (to paint) a large street mural near the library, so she cannot meet until dusk.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол explains стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвиг времён не выполняется — оставляем Present Continuous.

prompt: Owen called me two minutes ago from his front doorstep because he still cannot get inside without his spare key. Which sentence reports his call best?
options: Owen said that he loses his house key and is waiting by the gate.
Owen says that he would misplace his house key outside the front door.
Owen said that he has misplaced his house key and cannot get in.
Owen said that he was misplacing his house key on the doorstep.
explanation_ru: Звонок был только что, и результат сохраняется прямо сейчас, поэтому Present Perfect (has misplaced) и cannot без сдвига передают ситуацию точнее всего.

prompt: Closing her laptop at the café, Priya smiled with relief. She has told her brother that she finally (to finish) the college form. Earlier in the week, she complained that the website (to crash) every five minutes, though the tech team fixed it. Her brother offered to celebrate with dinner. Priya replied that she still (to hope) to hear back before May.
explanation_ru: После has told сдвиг не нужен (has finished); проблема с сайтом уже решена, поэтому нужен Past Simple/Continuous (crashed); надежда ещё актуальна (still), поэтому допустимы оба варианта.

prompt: Most pupils forgot the rule, so Declan's science teacher reminded them that sound ___ through empty space, no matter how loud the source is.
explanation_ru: Для научных фактов и общих истин время в косвенной речи не сдвигают — используют Present Simple (doesn't travel), а не didn't travel.

prompt: Sofia has just phoned me from the tram to warn that the oven was still on right now, so I am hurrying home.
answer: Sofia has just phoned me from the tram to warn that the oven is still on right now, so I am hurrying home.
accepted_answers: Sofia has just phoned me from the tram to warn that the oven is still on right now, so I am hurrying home.
explanation_ru: После Present Perfect (has just phoned) и при ситуации прямо сейчас (still … right now) сдвиг в прошедшее время ошибочен — нужно is.

prompt: Rain fell steadily while Kenji waited by the office gate. He says he (to forget) the entry code again, and his phone battery is flat. Last month, the caretaker told us that the gate (to lock) automatically at six, which is still the rule. We tried waving at the security desk through the glass. Eventually, the guard noticed us and explained that the keypad (not / to respond) properly yesterday, so he had reset all the numbers.
explanation_ru: После says сдвига в Past Perfect нет (has forgotten); постоянное правило после told допускает locks и locked; сбой вчера был разовым событием в прошлом, поэтому нужен сдвиг (hadn't responded / didn't respond).

prompt: Good news arrived at breakfast when Marek read the email. His sister tells me that he (to receive) a job offer from a firm in Cardiff. In autumn, he admitted that he (not / to expect) any replies before spring. Can you believe how fast his luck changed? Even better, he mentioned that the office still (to offer) flexible hours for new staff.
explanation_ru: После tells сдвиг в Past Perfect не нужен (has received); осенние ожидания уже в прошлом, поэтому нужен сдвиг (didn't expect); актуальные условия со словом still допускают offers и offered.
